dedupe_keys.name: dataset 8 experimental study of outdoor uav localization and tracking using passive rf sensing

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The experiment records a commercial UAV following outdoor trajectories while four passive RF sensors observe its signals. The source describes time-difference-of-arrival localisation and tracking observations. The data support evaluation of UAV tracking algorithms and motion models. The provider identifies UAV traffic management and search-and-rescue operations among the applications. These are experimental observations; the source does not establish operational air-traffic or emergency-service deployment. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: UAV traffic-management and localisation modelling. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
